jobs.title: Program Manager, Business Transformation & Platform Operations
jobs.why: Exceptional match for business transformation, operational excellence, enterprise platform enablement, reporting, automation, requirements gathering, testing, adoption, process documentation, and healthcare operations. The preferred stack explicitly includes Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and Dynamics 365.
jobs.gap: The posting asks for 5+ years across program management/transformation/business analysis. Emphasize cumulative systems, BA, healthcare operations, workflow automation, training, and cross-functional delivery experience without overstating tenure.

jobs.title: Executive Operations Manager, Tech
jobs.why: Strong digital-health operations role combining executive operating cadence, OKRs, cross-functional execution, vendor management, process systems, AI-enabled efficiency, documentation, and coordination across Engineering, Product, Design, and Analytics.
jobs.gap: Requires 5+ years in executive/technical operations and direct support of multiple VP/C-level leaders. Executive calendar/travel support is also a larger component than in your current work.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager, Enterprise Sales
jobs.why: Very strong systems-operations match centered on generative-AI automation, SOPs, knowledge management, training infrastructure, client onboarding, workflow mapping, spreadsheets, and cross-department execution.
jobs.gap: Role sits in enterprise sales operations rather than healthcare and wants 4–6 years in business operations/sales enablement/knowledge management. Frame marketing plus BA plus operations experience as one continuous systems-operations story.

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Cycle Strategy and Operations Manager
jobs.why: Excellent maternal/pediatric digital-health environment with healthcare workflow design, client onboarding, SOPs, operational quality, Product/Tech partnership, payer processes, metrics, and scalable systems work.
jobs.gap: Deep revenue-cycle expertise is the largest gap: the role asks for 5–7 years of RCM, claims, billing, denials, and payer-rule experience. SQL is only preferred, so keep SQL at foundational/working knowledge.

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.location: United States · Remote with occasional NYC travel
jobs.why: Strong healthcare-tech growth-operations role owning sales/account-management workflows, scalable commercial processes, systems strategy, data-driven decisions, issue escalation, and cross-functional execution.
jobs.gap: This is a senior analytical stretch and may expect deeper RevOps ownership and advanced ad-hoc analysis. Present CRM/process/reporting experience strongly but do not imply advanced SQL proficiency.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare/caregiving implementation role with enterprise onboarding, project management, process ownership, training, documentation, Salesforce, cross-functional coordination, and interest in AI-enabled workflows.
jobs.gap: The role asks for 7+ years in implementation/client services and experience with complex enterprise accounts, so seniority is the main stretch.

jobs.title: Program Senior Manager – State & Local Health
jobs.why: Direct healthcare technology/program-operations role involving Medicaid/state-health programs, cross-functional execution, change control, operational improvement, stakeholder management, reporting, and complex systems delivery.
jobs.gap: A significant senior stretch: GDIT wants 5+ years managing complex Medicaid/healthcare IT contracts plus substantial staff leadership and large-program responsibility.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.why: Strong growth-operations alignment around HubSpot, CRM data quality, workflow automation, AI agents, lead lifecycle, reporting, process design, documentation, integrations, and RevOps partnership; SEO is not the core responsibility.
jobs.gap: Requires 5–8+ years in marketing operations and deep hands-on HubSpot administration in B2B SaaS. Position prior marketing experience plus systems/automation work accurately without overstating platform depth.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare-AI marketing operations role focused on CRM/marketing automation, segmentation, data integrity, lead management, RevOps collaboration, scalable workflows, and AI-assisted automation rather than SEO.
jobs.gap: Pardot/Salesforce depth is preferred and the role may be more campaign-operations-heavy than your strongest healthcare/business-operations experience.

jobs.title: Revenue Strategy and Operations Manager
jobs.why: Health-tech growth operations role connecting growth, product, and finance while building KPIs, scalable processes, GTM planning, forecasting, HubSpot workflows, and executive reporting.
jobs.gap: The role is more revenue/GTM-analytics oriented than healthcare service operations, and the salary floor is below target. Confirm that the realistic offer is above $100K early in the process.
